name: v2.6.0
body:
## vphone 2.6.0

**Core Bundle**
- iOS 27.0.1 (24A446) iPhone guests boot. On a 27.0.1 restore, TXM's selector-24 pre-check rejected every manifest and init was killed at first boot. The new boot-chain patch `txm-boot-precheck_admission` admits them, and re-signed guest binaries now carry CS_ADHOC like Apple's own. A 27.0.1 machine created with an earlier bundle needs a new restore. (#572)
- Run iOS from other iPhone models' IPSWs: iPhone 16 Plus, 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max and 16e (iPhone17,4/1/2/5), and iPhone 17, Air, 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max and 17e (iPhone18,3/4/1/2/5). Each guest presents its own board. Only the iPhone 17 Pro has been booted so far; see `Documents/Guides/iphone-models.md`. iPhone17,3 is unchanged and is now named iPhone 16 in New Machine. (#580)
- iPhone17,3 guests get D47AP's product description: Siri, Action Button, Camera Control and dictation appear. `preboot-cfw-devicetree_iphone_product` is on in the standard preset and reaches existing machines through `cfw update-environment`. (#568)
- Settings › Battery › Battery Health shows a healthy battery instead of a spinner that never ends. (#573)
- Unlock at Startup: a per-machine setting (`vm config --unlock-at-startup on|off`, the VM window's Device menu, or Launchpad's machine Settings) that gets the guest past the Lock Screen after each boot. Guests still cannot have a passcode. (#571)
- Shut a guest down cleanly: vphoned's `system.shutdown` and **Device › Shut Down Guest…** let launchd stop services and unmount volumes before the VM stops. (#581)
- `vm stop` signals the machine's own `vphone-vm` instead of Virtualization's service, so a stop exits with status 0 instead of "虚拟机意外停止". (#579)
- The VM window's close button and ⌘Q ask before stopping a running guest. `vm stop` and Launchpad's Stop do not ask. (#571)
- Text or images copied in the guest by touch reach the Mac clipboard when the VM window loses focus. (#584)
- Menu shortcuts that never fired: Keychain Browser is ⌃⌘K, Copy Screenshot is ⌃⌘C, Save Screenshot is ⇧⌘S. (#574)
- Patches can change after a machine exists. `PatchReceipt.plist` records what is live in the guest, `fw patches <vm>` shows what each pending change needs, and `cfw install` / `cfw update-environment` now also revert guest patches that were turned off. (#570, #588)
- `cfw update-kernel <vm>` (root, VM off) re-patches the kernel with the machine's current selection and swaps it into Preboot, keeping the guest's data. `restore --no-erase` refuses, because a cloudOS restore always erases. A failed restore no longer exits 0. (#591, #588)
- `fw prepare` and `vm create` show IPSW download progress. (#593)
- The guest's `vphoned` updates itself the next time each machine starts.

**Launchpad**
- Machine Settings and New Machine show one page at a time under a segmented control; New Machine's advanced options are its third page. (#582)
- The inspector's Patches section has **Edit…**, **Apply to Guest** for pending guest patches and **Update Kernel** for pending kernel patches. (#583, #591)
- Stop shuts the guest down first and falls back to `vm stop` after 30 s or when the guest cannot be asked. (#581)
- The firmware step of New Machine, the machine table and the inspector show IPSW download progress. (#593)
- Developer Tools access granted or revoked in System Settings applies without reopening Launchpad. (#595, #594)
- Closing the window while a machine is being created asks first, and Cancel keeps the window. (#587)
- Finder and the Dock show "VPhone Launchpad". (#585)
- `vphone-launchpad-cli` starts Launchpad hidden unless `--foreground` is given. (#586)
- The helper (build 13) adds the kernel update and keeps the end of a root CFW run in the machine's console log; Launchpad reinstalls it on the next start. (#569)

**Upgrading**

Launchpad 2.6.0 needs `VPhone.bundle` 2.6.x, because machine Settings pass `vm config --unlock-at-startup`. Download the notarized `vphone-launchpad-2.6.0-notarized.zip`, then install `VPhone.bundle` 2.6.0 from Core Bundle and move your machines to it with **Change Core Bundle…** (turn on **Update guest environment** to get the new guest patches). Launchpad 2.5.x does not work with this bundle. The `vphone-launchpad-2.6.0.zip` built by CI is unsigned.

The first-package step of the package environment guide is now the single `owngoal-bootstrap-vphone` package. (#589)
